title: DECREE YOUR PATH
IN THE MIDNIGHT HOUR
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight
stock_queries: deep blue starry night sky over silhouette mountains
golden candle flame flickering in dark stone room
misty forest path at night illuminated by moonlight
open old bible on wooden table under soft lamp
distant lighthouse beam cutting through midnight fog

scenes.a: That recurring doubt haunting your thoughts right now is not the final word for you.
Your spirit knows there is power in spoken truth beneath the silence of these stars.
Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.
Father, we stand in this quiet watch claiming the authority You have placed in us.
May every heavy burden be lifted as we align our hearts with Your eternal promise.
Guide our steps through the morning and let Your peace rest upon this soul tonight.
